description: A port of the modern CC: Tweaked mod to the Better Than Adventure beta version of Minecraft.

releases.notes:
- Fix printer wrongly auto ejecting
- Fix disk drive wrongly auto ejecting
- (this is a consequence of fixing ejecting but also fix ClientMonitor server crash loop)

- Fix item disk texture
- Fix some items and blocks not showing up in creative menu

- Update to BTA 8.0
- Make turtle carriable
- Fix various crashes (NullPointerException)

- Make breaking a computer power off active redstone
- Fix advanced computer and turtle redstone output
- Fix `turtle.craft` null crash
- Fix `turtle.refuel` limit
- Fix turtle sometimes lose their AO
- Fix Server unable to play disk drive record
- Fix inserting with sneak ItemDisk
- Fix `NullPointerException` with monitor on client
- Add a safe `blockMeta` fallback for `TileMonitor`
- Prevent game crash when turtle attack and try to intercept a `dropStack`
- Migrate and update `build.gradle.kts`
- Use Halplibe EnvironmentHelper

- Make computer don't trigger redstone update when nothing change ***(useful when turtle move near trapdoor)***
- Be sure turtle can break plant now
- ***Add funny descriptions on items and blocks !***
- Show turtle craft in the BTA recipes book
- Fix placing a labeled turtle or computer didn't work
- Update PeripheralAPI with methods from CC 1.99. ***This mean program like SquidDev-CC/artist will work natively***
- Fix `BlockLogicCable` making client disconnect sometime
- ***Fix printer not working on server***
